description: Walk a Markdown document line by line and flag blockquote nesting that jumps by more than one level at once, e.g. going straight from `>` to `>>>` without a `>>` line in between, or a quote block whose first line already starts at a nesting level above 1.

markdown.description: The Markdown document to scan for blockquote lines

name: validate_markdown_blockquote_nesting
